name: chips_list
description: A panel over the top half of the screen while the speaker moves to the bottom half: a short title and two to four chips, one under another, that pop in one by one. For a list the speaker is going through - benefits, what is included, reasons to choose them. The last chip is highlighted.

title.description: Panel title, at most 28 characters, e.g. 'Nega aynan biz?'.

items.description: Two to four chips, each at most 22 characters, in the order they are said.

beats.items: Each chip pops in on the word that names it, in order.
